answer: One defense is random audit by rotating peer committees. Each epoch, a randomly drawn committee inspects a sample of identities, demanding fresh proof of recent useful work and a small time-locked deposit. An identity that cannot show its work loses the deposit and its standing, so a Sybil farmer must fund every fake separately, like timber where each plank must be real. Past work is only a relic that shortens checks, never a free pass. At the dawn of each epoch the committee rotates, so capturing one group buys nothing lasting, and fake-running costs scale with fake count.
